visual_action: A static image of a fake Halloween costume package. The package is styled like one from the brand Spirit Halloween and is titled 'Walz Costume Kit'. It features a photoshopped image of a man, identified as Tim Walz, wearing a red and black buffalo plaid shirt, jeans, and a yellow hard hat. Text on the package lists the supposed contents of the costume kit.

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: An image of him is featured on the fake costume package, which is labeled 'Walz Costume Kit'.

cast.name: Spirit Halloween
cast.evidence: The costume package is a parody of the brand's products, featuring its 'SPIRIT' logo at the top.

spoken_summary: The audio contains a short, excited voice clip saying "Here we go!" followed by music. There is no other dialogue.
audio_music: The video starts with a spoken phrase "Here we go!" immediately followed by an upbeat, high-energy rock song with a stadium-anthem feel.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single static image.
manipulation_or_satire: The image is a digitally fabricated Halloween costume package. A photograph of Tim Walz has been superimposed onto the package, and the text describing the 'costume kit' has been added to create a satirical meme.
central_claim: Tim Walz's persona and political identity can be satirically reduced to a set of Midwestern stereotypes and specific Minnesota-related items.
intended_effect: To mock and belittle Tim Walz by portraying him as a caricature.
